intervals.label: water-fill commissioning phase
intervals.locator: arXiv:2104.11687 (JINST 16 P08059), description of the three operating phases
intervals.note: The collaboration's detector paper dates the water phase (the acrylic vessel filled with 905 t of ultrapure water, run as a water Cherenkov detector) to May 2017 - July 2019; the paper says the purpose of the water fill was to re-commission the detector and mitigate radon ingress.
intervals.quote: The water phase was used to collect physics data by operating SNO+ as a water Cherenkov detector from May 2017 to July 2019 while filled with 905 tonnes of UPW.

end.display: by April 2026 (leak repair under way); onset not sourced

intervals.label: liquid-scintillator phase
intervals.note: Start is taken as May 2022, the date of the SNOLAB news item announcing the scintillator fill and PPO loading complete; earlier filling steps are not dated here. By April 2026 the acrylic-vessel leak repair was under way (LIP slide: "lowering water now to repair"); the date it began is not sourced.
intervals.quote: The SNO+ experiment completes scintillator fill and PPO loading May 17, 2022 ... has completed the liquid scintillator detector fill and PPO loading marking a huge milestone for the experiment.

intervals.label: tellurium-loaded phase (planned: 0.5% Te fill from 2028)
intervals.locator: slide 5 'SNO+ timeline and plans': in the 2026-2032 timeline, 'Repairs' occupies 2026-2027 and the green 'Fill 0.5% Te' bar starts at the 2028 tick
intervals.note: April 2026 slide: 0.5% fill from 2028 (read from the timeline figure, not from text), '0.5% data' after it, 'Fill 1.5% Te' around 2030-2032 and '1.5% data' last; "0.5%: best sensitivity to 130Te 0vbb (2x10^26 yr in 3 yrs). Submitted proposal for 1.5% loading". A schedule, not an event.

intervals.label: acrylic vessel leak repair
intervals.note: LIP Advisory Committee slide (27-28 April 2026, J. Maneira): "Acrylic Vessel Repairs: leak in AV, height identified, lowering water now to repair, autumn restart". SNOLAB report of 26 May 2026 has a slide 'SNO+ Cavity Access for Repairs' (rope-access team, boat in the cavity, "No damage to the neck. AV was not stuck", "Installing lights"; photo of the cavity with the water level lowered), so the repair was under way in spring 2026. No source gives the day the scintillator data-taking stopped (the April 2026 reactor analysis, arXiv:2604.05746, uses data "between May 2022 and July 2025", which is an analysis cut, not an end of running), so the start is 'by April 2026' at month precision, approximate. The restart is a plan: 'autumn restart' (autumn 2026 = September-November, middle month 2026-10); the slide does not say what restarts (scintillator data-taking or water fill) and no source dated after 26 May 2026 reports it, so the shutdown is kept at 2026-10-25 and must be re-checked.
intervals.quote: leak in AV, height identified, lowering water now to repair, autumn restart

start.display: by April 2026 (leak repair under way); onset not sourced

quantity.note: The SNO+ collaboration's About page gives 780 tonnes of liquid scintillator in the acrylic vessel; SNOLAB's May 2022 news item says the same after the fill.
quantity.quote: The heart of the SNO+ detector is a 12m diameter acrylic sphere filled with 780 tonnes of liquid scintillator

lineage.note: SNO+ reuses SNO's cavern and acrylic vessel at SNOLAB per the official site's own description; the inverse `upgraded_to` row on experiment:sno is derived at build, not authored here.

name: SNO+
notes: The 'planned' tellurium-loading interval's date is a schema-satisfying placeholder (2027) explicitly flagged as unsourced for that year; only the existence of a future tellurium phase is sourced.

physics_goals.quote: the search for neutrinoless double beta decay
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double beta decay of 130-Te

physics_goals.quote: lowest background solar electron scattering signal above 5 MeV to date
physics_goals.value: Measure the 8B solar neutrino flux via elastic scattering

physics_goals.quote: Initial measurement of reactor antineutrino oscillations at SNO+
physics_goals.value: Measure reactor antineutrino oscillations over long baselines

summary.plain: SNO+ reuses the same underground cavern and acrylic ball that SNO used, now filled with liquid scintillator, to search for a hypothetical nuclear decay and to study solar and reactor neutrinos.
summary.technical: Multipurpose experiment at SNOLAB reusing SNO's acrylic vessel and cavern: water-fill commissioning 2017-2019, then 780 t liquid-scintillator fill from 2022, with a planned future tellurium-loading phase for a neutrinoless double-beta-decay search; also measures 8B solar neutrinos and long-baseline reactor antineutrino oscillations.

unique_capabilities.value: Reuses the original SNO acrylic vessel and cavern, refilled first with water, then liquid scintillator, and eventually tellurium-loaded scintillator, for a multi-phase, multi-purpose physics program
